feature: Pin an actual organism and compare inherited variation across islands and recorded generations
changes: Ephemeral reference A resolves to an actual birth record and stays pinned during island, species, generation and settings changes.
Each comparison member shows its identity, birth generation and island, both inherited trait copies, their mean and the separate neutral marker.
B minus A is shown only for different organisms of the same species and is labeled in inherited trait index points, not fitness.
Trait-copy matches compare unrounded, unordered values; A/a and a/A are the same neutral-marker genotype.
Inspect pinned organism selects its birth cohort and island, synchronizes both selectors and focuses the full organism record.
Replacing the founding frame clears the pin even when the seed and organism IDs are reused. Pinning does not save or change the simulation.

newTestsCover: Reversed inherited trait copies and heterozygote marker order

Different raw copies whose displayed values round identically
